attchmntText: BGR Energy Systems Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 16, 2026, titled "Newspaper Publication of un-audited Financial Results for the Quarter and Half year ended 30th September 2026.".
voiceSummary: BGR Energy Systems Limited published un-audited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026 in Business Standard and Prajasakti. The company reported a net loss after tax of 72196 lakhs for the quarter ended 30th September 2026 and 77626 lakhs for the half year ended 30th September 2026. Mini Diamonds India Limited published its un-audited consolidated financial results for the same period. The company reported a half year revenue growth of 64.26 percent and a profit after tax growth of 27.37 percent. Tata Capital Housing Finance Limited issued a physical possession notice for immovable property in Villianur, Puducherry, against borrower Mr. Iyappan Krishnamoorthy for an outstanding amount of 3440152 rupees. Edelweiss Asset Reconstruction Company Limited issued an e-auction notice for immovable secured assets against borrower Mr. Afsar Khan for outstanding dues of 3309398.22 rupees. The auction is scheduled for 16th December 2026 at 12.30 PM.

attchmntText: BGR Energy Systems Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: BGR Energy Systems Limited reported a net loss of 72196 lakhs for the quarter ended 30th September 2026. The Board approved the unaudited standalone financial results. The auditor highlighted material uncertainties regarding going concern due to working capital borrowings assigned to NARCL. Significant claims of 162042 lakhs and 76980 lakhs were raised for additional works on NUPPL Ghatampur and NTTPS Vijayawada contracts. The company recognized impairment allowances of 57604 lakhs for credit-impaired trade receivables from terminated NCTPS and other projects. An additional impairment of 27967 lakhs was recorded for NTPC projects. Operational creditor balances of 3056.75 lakhs were written back. Revenue from operations was 1627 lakhs for the quarter.

attchmntText: BGR Energy Systems Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 13, 2026, titled "Newspaper Publication pertaining to Postal Ballot Notice of the Company".
voiceSummary: BGR Energy Systems Limited published a newspaper advertisement regarding its Postal Ballot Notice in Business Standard and Prajasakti on 13th November 2026. Separately, Tata Capital Housing Finance Limited issued demand notices under Section 13 of the SARFAESI Act to six borrowers. The notices require repayment of outstanding dues as of 5th November 2026 within 60 days. The amounts due are Rs. 25,00,262 for Mr. Illaiyaraja and Mrs. Chitra, Rs. 42,76,736 for Mrs. Radha M, Mr. Murugan, and Mrs. Jancy M, Rs. 29,32,960 for Mr. N. Karthick and Mrs. Bhuvaneswari, Rs. 18,08,894 for Mrs. Parimala and Mr. Anandan, Rs. 25,18,193 for Mr. Jeyapal and Mrs. Padhma V, and Rs. 10,21,145 for Mr. Phinon and Mrs. Paulin. Grihum Housing Finance Limited announced an e-auction for immovable assets on 30th November 2026 via bankauctions.com.

attchmntText: BGR Energy Systems Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Notice of Postal Ballot
voiceSummary: BGR Energy Systems Limited has issued a notice for a postal ballot to seek shareholder approval for three resolutions. The first item is the appointment of Mr. Ram Naresh Singh Tomar, with DIN 08784935, as Whole-Time Director for five years from 26th October 2026 to 25th October 2031. The second item is an increase in the company's authorized share capital and alteration of the Memorandum of Association. The third item is approval for revised remuneration for Director Mr. Ganesan Jeyakrishna, with DIN 03208035. Remote e-voting is facilitated by National Securities Depository Limited. The voting period begins at 09:00 AM on Friday, 13th November 2026, and ends at 05:00 PM on Saturday, 12th December 2026. Results will be declared within two working days after the conclusion of voting.
